name: DEI lending sAMM spot-oracle liquidation drain
summary: The DEI lending contract priced collateral from the sAMM-USDC/DEI pool's spot balances, so the attacker flash-borrowed 24,772,798 DEI out of that same pool to crash the reported collateral value, liquidated the newly insolvent users through helper contract 0xb8f5c9e18abbb21dfa4329586ee74f1e2b685009, burned the seized LP for 5,218,173 USDC plus DEI, and kept 3,001,552.4990983484 DEI after repaying the flash loans.
notes: Directly deployed DEI lending runtime pricing collateral from sAMM-USDC/DEI spot balances since creation. No proxy code-selection path; the runtime hashes identically at deployment and immediately before the incident.

Exact receipt accounting: net 3001552.4990983484 DEI into the attack contract across the flash-loan, liquidation, LP-burn, and swap steps, with USDC and LP legs netting to zero in-tx. DEI still held its $1 peg at the incident timestamp, and the attacker subsequently bridged 3m USDC via Multichain, converting to 200,000 DAI plus 1,101.8 ETH (about $3.1m) before Tornado Cash, corroborating par. The team reimbursed liquidated users, so the protocol absorbed the loss. No attacker-supplied campaign inputs besides gas.
